# Martha Stewart

> > America's leading lifestyle destination for home, cooking, gardening, and entertaining inspiration.

MarthaStewart.com offers expert-backed guides and practical advice across cooking, gardening, home care, and seasonal entertaining. Content features insights from culinary institutions like the Institute of Culinary Education, botanical experts from Longwood Gardens, and trusted home care specialists.

## Key Topics

- Cooking techniques and kitchen tips
- Garden design and plant care
- Holiday cooking and entertaining
- Home cleaning and hygiene
- Seasonal recipes and celebrations
- Food safety and storage
- Houseplant care and repotting
- Border plants and landscaping
- Expert advice from culinary professionals
- Bathroom and home sanitation
- Fast-growing plants
- Orchid care
- Food preservation methods
- Entertaining portion guides

## Cooking & Kitchen Guides

- [How to Cook Green Beans 9 Different Ways](https://www.marthastewart.com/how-to-cook-green-beans-11907155): Nine cooking methods for green beans from stovetop to air fryer
- [4 Foods Experts Say You Should Never Wrap in Aluminum Foil](https://www.marthastewart.com/foods-never-wrap-in-aluminum-foil-11908915): Food scientists explain aluminum foil safety and acidic food storage
- [How to Make Jam Using Any Fruit in 45 Minutes](https://www.marthastewart.com/how-to-make-jam-8704189): Sarah Carey's no-canning freezer jam method for any fruit in 45 minutes
- [How To Keep Guacamole From Turning Brown](https://www.marthastewart.com/how-to-keep-guacamole-from-turning-brown-11920855): Food scientist explains enzymatic browning prevention in guacamole
- [How to Toast Coconut—and Delicious Ways to Use It](https://www.marthastewart.com/how-to-toast-coconut-8551649): Pastry chef techniques for perfectly toasted coconut every time
- [What Is Chai Masala and How Do You Use It?](https://www.marthastewart.com/8211267/chai-masala-spice-blend-explained): Spicewalla experts explain chai masala blend and cooking applications

- [When to Plant Corn for a Bountiful Harvest](https://www.marthastewart.com/when-to-plant-corn-11917904): Corn planting schedule guide with USDA zone frost protection tips
- [9 Fast-Growing Border Plants to Quickly Transform Your Garden](https://www.marthastewart.com/fast-growing-border-plants-11925711): Guide to fast-growing border plants for garden transformation
- [10 Small Front Yard Landscaping Ideas That Make a Big Impact, According to Designers](https://www.marthastewart.com/small-front-yard-landscaping-ideas-7557809): Designer tips for maximizing curb appeal in small front yards
